newsitem.title: USA: Basic Petroleum completes Guatemala well.
newsitem.headline: Basic Petroleum completes Guatemala well.

text.p: Basic Petroleum International Ltd on Friday said it completed a development well in the northern part of its Xan field in Guatemala.
The well, known as Xan-14, tested at 2,650 barrels of oil per day, bringing Basic's daily production to about 23,000 barrels.

"The completion of Xan-14 marks the 12th successful well drilled in the Xan field, two of which were completed in 1997. We will continue to increase our production from this valuable field from the 12 wells in production and the added production from two development wells to be drilled in 1997," Basic Petroleum said in a statement.
